readout_other: widefield GCaMP6f calcium fluorescence imaging; intrinsic signal optical imaging of HbO, HbR, HbT
direction_notes: TUS increased neuronal calcium oscillation intensity and HbO/HbT and decreased HbR in the visual cortex; calcium peak value, peak time and duration increased with stimulation duration.

exposures.label: TUS of mouse visual cortex, stimulation duration 0.3-0.7 s

timing.protocol_description: 500 kHz, 1 kHz PRF, 10% duty cycle; stimulation duration 0.4 s in the main protocol and varied from 0.3 to 0.7 s in 0.1 s steps; one stimulus every 10 s; 8 trials averaged, repeated after 30 min.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Adult Thy1-GCaMP6f transgenic mice were used in the experiments (total, n 15; normal hearing mice, n 9; deaf male mice, n 6; body weight, 20–25 g; age, 10–12 weeks; Jackson Laboratory)
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: In the ultrasound system, the fundamental frequency, pulsed repetition frequency, and duty cycle were 500 kHz, 0.4 s, 1 kHz, and 10%, respectively (Fig. 1b)
